My father bought in 1989. He talked about it until he died
That was a long time ago
He waited 20 years and it still hadn't come back

steps.title: December 1989 to February 2024
steps.body: Japan's main stock index peaked at the end of 1989. By 2009 it had fallen about 80%. It passed its old peak only in 2024: **34 years** later. Someone who put everything in at the top waited most of a working life. Simplified from real data.

steps.prompt: How much must a price rise to get back after a fall? Find the fall that needs a +400% rise.

goal.hint: It's the fall Japan's index had by 2009.

steps.prompt: A portfolio falls 50%. Afterwards it grows 7% a year. How many years until it's back where it started?
steps.reveal: About 10 years: −50% needs +100%, and 7% a year doubles money in about ten. Michiko retires in 7. A deep fall now could outlast her working years.

steps.prompt: Why does the same −50% fall weigh more at 58 than at 27?
options: There may not be enough years left to recover before the money is needed
Falls are deeper for older investors
steps.explanation: The fall is the same; the [[time-horizon]] isn't. At 27, ten years of recovery fit before most goals. At 58, they run into retirement.

goal.hint: Try −80%: only a fifth is left.

t1.body: Japan's main share index was highest at the end of 1989. By 2009 it was about 80% lower. It was higher than in 1989 again only in 2024: **34 years** later.

s1.prompt: After a fall, how much must a price go up to get back? Find the fall that needs +400% to get back.

output.label: How much it must go up

p1.prompt: Money falls by half. Then it grows 7% every year. How many years until it is back? Guess.
p1.reveal: About 10 years. Half must double, and 7% a year doubles money in about ten years. Michiko stops working in 7 years.

q1.prompt: Why is a −50% fall worse at 58 than at 27?
options: There may not be enough years to get the money back before you need it
Prices fall more for older people
q1.explanation: The fall is the same. But at 58 there is less time before the money is needed. How long money can wait is the [[time-horizon]].
